name: Afrobeat Piano
description: Piano and electric piano sounds for Afrobeat comping: a bright grand, an electric grand, a Wurlitzer and a Pianet. Short releases and a light low cut keep stabs tight and leave room for the bass.

patches.name: Bright Grand
patches.note: Yamaha C5 grand (Salamander), 16 velocity layers. Natural-tuned recordings moved to equal temperament.

patches.name: Electric Grand
patches.note: Yamaha CP80 electric grand, 4 velocity layers. Cut-off samples are looped where a loop could be found.

patches.name: Wurlitzer EP200
patches.note: Wurlitzer EP200, 4 velocity layers. Reed tones are looped so held chords keep sounding.

patches.name: Pianet T
patches.note: Hohner Pianet T, 2 velocity layers. Key-release noise samples are not played yet.
